summary:
DH-4b（Alembic 侧 shared-asset-drift 门禁 per-host 化 + 3 资产转绿）。基线 cf3b171 → main 提交 88a2abf（直提 main，仅改 2 文件 +51/-10）。门禁 RED(3 drift)→3 目标资产 GREEN；完全 0-drift 经镜像证明（仅需控制器派 Plugin 同步 2 个 self-check 文件，无需改 plugin 任何资产）。

【设计】采 §C.1 primary 的 manifest 级 per-host 模型（recipes/structure 是多行多处工具面分叉，不适合单行 wakeflow-host:<host> 段提升；且不可改 plugin 资产）：
- scripts/check-shared-asset-drift.mjs：checkSkillSharedSections 加可选 perHostSections——声明段承载真 host-divergent 工具面（codex/main alembic_knowledge/alembic_guard/alembic_structure ↔ cc/plugin alembic_search/alembic_code_guard/alembic_project_matrix），从 cross-host coherence 排除（每侧即该 host per-host 权威，互不比较，保各宿主四工具对外 MCP 语义），其余 shared 段仍须 codex/cc 一致；并校验声明段存在于 main 权威侧。无 perHostSections 的资产行为不变。
- config/shared-asset-manifest.json：recipes perHostSections=[intro-and-overview,use-context-tail]；structure perHostSections=[title-intro,tools-and-graph]；templates-recipes-setup 加 README.md fileVariants（3 个 host-divergent 工具表行，复用既有 directory-exact 变体机制）。

【门禁 before→after（Node v22.22.1）】before(cf3b171)：11 checks/3 drift（recipes intro-and-overview·use-context-tail 段；structure title-intro·tools-and-graph 段；recipes-setup README.md）。after(88a2abf) vs 真实 plugin：3 目标资产全 [ok]（recipes 3 shared+2 per-host skipped；structure 0 shared+2 per-host skipped；recipes-setup 6 files in sync），仅剩 2 self-check drift（manifest+script，plugin 副本未同步）。镜像（plugin 资产原样、仅同步 2 self-check 文件）：11 checks/0 drift/PASS。

【per-host 提升清单】host-divergent 行未逐行入文件级 wakeflow-host:<host> 段（多行多处分叉 + 不可改 plugin 资产边界），改为 manifest 级 per-host 声明（§C.1 primary codex/cc variant）：recipes 的 Context index/搜索表格/MCP 列表/confirm_usage/semantic 行落在 intro-and-overview·use-context-tail（声明 per-host）；structure 的 alembic_structure(targets|files|metadata)↔alembic_project_matrix + 知识图谱↔项目图谱行落在 title-intro·tools-and-graph（声明 per-host）；README 3 行入 fileVariants。

【needs-controller】Plugin self-check 2 文件字节同步：派 AlembicPlugin 窗口用 main 88a2abf 版覆盖 config/shared-asset-manifest.json + scripts/check-shared-asset-drift.mjs（精确 diff/指引见 wakeflow-ledger/Alembic/dh-4b-plugin-self-check-sync-2026-06-20.patch + .md）。同步后整门禁 0 drift；无需改 plugin 任何资产。

【边界】只改 Alembic 2 个门禁文件；不动 plugin；四工具对外 MCP 语义不变（main 工具名保留在 codex 侧）；AlembicCore 未动；Node≥22 跑门禁。

risks: WHOLE-GATE 0-drift requires controller to dispatch AlembicPlugin to byte-sync the 2 self-check files (manifest+script) per ledger package; until then npm run check / drift gate stays RED on self-check ONLY (3 target assets already green). No plugin asset edits needed (mirror-proven).

structure skill now has 0 cross-host coherence-checked shared sections (both sections are host-divergent → both per-host) — honest tradeoff given plugin assets can't be edited; a future two-sided restructure could reintroduce coherence on host-agnostic prose.

DESIGN INTERPRETATION to confirm: host-divergent lines declared per-host at the MANIFEST level (§C.1 primary codex/cc variant), NOT lifted into file-level wakeflow-host:<host> begin/end sections inside the SKILL.md — chosen because divergence is multi-line/multi-location and the boundary forbids editing plugin assets (literal file-level two-sided markers would need a coordinated plugin asset restructure, a bigger needs-controller scope). Flag if controller wants the literal marker form.

AGENTS.md '差异声明表' for skill-alembic-recipes/structure still says '仅比较 wakeflow-shared 标记段' — minor doc staleness now that perHostSections also applies; not edited (outside the task's stated 2-file boundary).
